newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ local profits outperform offshore.
newsitem.headline: ANZ local profits outperform offshore.

text.p: The profit growth of Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd's (ANZ) offshore units was flatter in the first half of 1996/97 than ANZ's Australian operations, ANZ's accounts showed on Wednesday.
ANZ's overall group net profit before abnormals rose 24 percent to A$646 million in the six months to March 31, while net profit after abnormals rose 18 percent to A$615 million.
ANZ's Australian operations were the largest contributor to this overal profit growth, with their operating profits after tax rising 35 percent from the year ago period to A$405 million.
However profits from ANZ's international and New Zealand operations rose 10 percent to A$241 million.
New Zealand profits rose to A$77 million from A$70 million in the second half of 1995/96 and A$68 million in the first half of 1995/96.

"In New Zealand, underlying earnings remained stable, with net provision releases and a lower effective tax rate leading to a moderate increase in after tax profit," ANZ chief executive Don Mercer said in the accounts.
"The general slowdown in the New Zealand economy constrained asset growth," he said.
